Compatibility impact: Against Python 3.12, which CI uses (Unicode 15.0), 5,004 characters are word characters (str.isalnum or _) in bench-tools and not in Python, the letters and digits Unicode 15.1 and 16.0 added; none the other way. Older interpreters differ on more: Python 3.10 (Unicode 13.0) on 9,917. Python 3.14 agrees on every character. None of the repository's tracked audit records contains any of those characters. Resolving issue: #236.

calibration-fixture-approved-without-rec.reason: Adopt for #149's cleanup of deleted Python names, by the repository owner's direction, delegated through the migration's orchestration on 2026-10-22. Supersedes decision-1563eaa732c3bd51c17a915d790cbeb0ef00a543175b93c9b13c414b7e6019a8 and changes wording only. Old behavior: the message named the deleted Python program or a Python exception from a deleted module. New behavior: it names the bench-tools command that printed it, or a plain label: `calibration.py: ` becomes `bench-tools calibration: `. The message body, exit code and stdout/stderr split are unchanged. Rationale: the Python programs are deleted, so their names misled anyone reading the message. Compatibility impact: a reader matching the old label must match the new one; frozen runs execute their own pinned code and are unaffected. Resolving issue: #149.
